example: Engineers will inspect the bridge for signs of structural damage.
exampleCn: 工程师将检查这座桥是否有结构损坏的迹象。

mnemonic: in+tend(伸展)→心里向某方向「伸展」，打算。
example: The author intends to explore the issue in greater depth.
exampleCn: 作者打算更深入地探讨这个问题。

mnemonic: inter(在…之间)+pret(解释)→在两者间「解释」，口译。
example: Different scholars interpret the ancient text in different ways.
exampleCn: 不同的学者以不同的方式解读这部古代文献。

mnemonic: in+vest(衣服)+igate→深入「查」个究竟，调查。
example: Scientists will investigate the cause of the sudden decline.
exampleCn: 科学家将调查这种骤然下降的原因。

example: Technicians maintain the equipment to keep it running smoothly.
exampleCn: 技术人员维护设备，使其平稳运转。

example: The team had to modify the design after the first test failed.
exampleCn: 第一次测试失败后，团队不得不修改设计。

mnemonic: mon(警告)+itor→时刻盯着发出警告，监测。
example: Sensors monitor the temperature of the reactor around the clock.
exampleCn: 传感器昼夜不停地监测反应堆的温度。

example: Students can obtain a library card at the front desk.
exampleCn: 学生可以在前台领取借书证。

example: It is obvious that the two accounts cannot both be true.
exampleCn: 显然，这两种说法不可能都正确。

example: The new library will occupy the entire second floor.
exampleCn: 新图书馆将占据整个二楼。

example: The machine will not operate properly without regular cleaning.
exampleCn: 这台机器不定期清洁就无法正常运转。

example: Dark surfaces absorb more heat than light ones.
exampleCn: 深色表面比浅色表面吸收更多热量。

example: A teaching assistant will accompany the students on the field trip.
exampleCn: 一名助教将陪同学生参加这次实地考察。

mnemonic: a+chieve(达到)+ment→达到目标取得的「成就」。
example: Winning the science fair was her greatest academic achievement.
exampleCn: 赢得科学竞赛是她最大的学术成就。

example: The scholar acknowledged the limitations of his own research.
exampleCn: 这位学者承认了自己研究的局限性。

mnemonic: add(加)+ition→「加」的动作或结果，加法/增加。
example: In addition to the main experiment, the team ran several controls.
exampleCn: 除主实验外，团队还做了几组对照。

example: The university offers additional funding for graduate researchers.
exampleCn: 这所大学为研究生提供额外的资助。

mnemonic: ad+dress(指向)→把话「指向」听众，发表演讲；也指地址。
example: The dean will address the issue at the next faculty meeting.
exampleCn: 院长将在下次教师会议上处理这个问题。

example: The university administration announced a new housing policy.
exampleCn: 这所大学的行政部门宣布了一项新的住宿政策。

example: Admission to the program requires a strong research proposal.
exampleCn: 进入该项目需要一份出色的研究计划。

mnemonic: ad(向)+vert(转)+isement→把注意力「转向」商品，广告。
example: The advertisement appeared in several national newspapers.
exampleCn: 这则广告刊登在几家全国性报纸上。

mnemonic: af+fair(公平)→需要公平处理的「事务」。
example: The department treats every student affair with great care.
exampleCn: 该部门非常谨慎地处理每一件学生事务。

mnemonic: a+gree(同意)+ment→双方「同意」达成，协议。
example: The two universities signed an agreement to share research facilities.
exampleCn: 两所大学签署了共享研究设施的协议。

example: A narrow path lies ahead of the hikers.
exampleCn: 徒步者前方有一条狭窄的小路。

example: The charity provided aid to villages after the flood.
exampleCn: 这家慈善机构向洪水过后的村庄提供援助。

mnemonic: 联想日常词 air→我们呼吸的「空气」。
example: The mountain air is thin and cold at high altitudes.
exampleCn: 高海拔处的山间空气稀薄而寒冷。

mnemonic: amb(周围)+ass(走)+ador→被派往四方「行走」的代表，大使。
example: The ambassador promoted cultural exchange between the two countries.
exampleCn: 这位大使促进了两国之间的文化交流。

mnemonic: ambi(周围)+tion→四处奔走追求目标，「抱负」。
example: Her ambition to become a researcher drove her to study harder.
exampleCn: 她想成为研究者的抱负促使她更加努力学习。

mnemonic: ana(分开)+lysis(解开)→把整体「拆开」研究，分析。
example: A careful analysis of the data revealed a clear pattern.
exampleCn: 对数据的仔细分析揭示出一个清晰的模式。

mnemonic: ap+peal(呼吁)→公开「呼吁」，也指吸引力。
example: The museum's new exhibit appeals to visitors of all ages.
exampleCn: 这座博物馆的新展览吸引着各个年龄段的游客。

example: Students appreciate a professor who explains difficult ideas clearly.
exampleCn: 学生欣赏能把难点讲清楚的教授。

example: The committee approved the budget for the new laboratory.
exampleCn: 委员会批准了新实验室的预算。

example: The ancient city was built approximately three thousand years ago.
exampleCn: 这座古城大约建于三千年前。

mnemonic: argu(争论)+ment→争论时提出的「论点」。
example: The essay presents a convincing argument for stronger conservation.
exampleCn: 这篇文章为加强环境保护提出了一个令人信服的论点。

mnemonic: arm(武器)+ed→配有「武器」的，武装的。
example: The museum displays armed guards from the medieval period.
exampleCn: 博物馆陈列着中世纪时期武装卫兵的展品。

mnemonic: arm(武器)+y→持有武器的群体，「军队」。
example: The army was sent to provide relief after the earthquake.
exampleCn: 军队被派去在地震后提供救援。

example: The seating arrangement places students in small groups.
exampleCn: 座位安排把学生分成小组。

example: The report examines every aspect of the ecosystem.
exampleCn: 这份报告考察了生态系统的方方面面。

example: Tutors assist students who struggle with difficult concepts.
exampleCn: 导师帮助那些理解难点的学生。

mnemonic: as+soci(社会)+ate→把事物「联」到一起，关联。
example: Researchers associate the habit with higher rates of disease.
exampleCn: 研究人员把这一习惯与更高的发病率联系起来。

example: The professor assured students that the exam would be fair.
exampleCn: 教授向学生保证考试会是公平的。

mnemonic: atmo(蒸气)+sphere(球)→包裹地球的「大气」层。
example: The atmosphere of Mars is much thinner than Earth's.
exampleCn: 火星的大气层比地球的大气层稀薄得多。

example: The disease attacks the immune system and weakens the body.
exampleCn: 这种疾病侵袭免疫系统，使身体虚弱。

mnemonic: auto(自己)+mat(做)+ic→自己「做」的，自动的。
example: The door has an automatic sensor that opens it on approach.
exampleCn: 这扇门装有自动感应器，人靠近时就会打开。

example: The average temperature in July is much higher than in January.
exampleCn: 七月的平均气温比一月高得多。

example: Knowing the historical background helps explain the painting.
exampleCn: 了解历史背景有助于解读这幅画。

example: Some bacteria in the soil help plants absorb nutrients.
exampleCn: 土壤中的一些细菌帮助植物吸收养分。

example: A basic understanding of statistics is useful in many courses.
exampleCn: 对统计学的基本了解在许多课程中都有用。

example: The theory rests on a solid basis of experimental evidence.
exampleCn: 这一理论建立在坚实的实验证据基础之上。

example: The battle lasted for days and changed the course of history.
exampleCn: 这场战斗持续了数日，改变了历史进程。
